4 Selection

of standard

This standard aims at rationalization of various sizes of compression springs eliminating the unnecessary sizes and retainrng those most commonly used in the industry. This standard is expected to be of considerable help to the spring designer who can choose the spring required by him from the list. Some of the most commonly used springs may be available as standard springs from stocks of spring manufacturers. 21
